scene: sunlit Chinese high-school corridor; the figures fill the right ~45%, the left half left deliberately empty for the wordmark and tagline

style_lock.name: campus-watercolour-cartoon
style_lock.note: All future PhysicsOS character art follows this style: bright watercolour cartoon, large expressive eyes, soft rounded faces, clean fine linework, warm daylight, white-leaning background. Not photographic, not 3D matte, not Q-version chibi.

character_sheet.boy: black short hair, slightly tousled; cream knit short-sleeve tee with a buttoned placket
character_sheet.girl: long dark wavy hair with bangs; clear round glasses; navy striped top; dark knit cardigan
character_sheet.cat: silver tabby; CREAM BACK PATCH (its signature mark, must never be dropped); white muzzle and chest; grey forehead tabby M; pink nose; big pointed ears with pink inner ear; amber round eyes; dark tail tip; pale blue collar

derivatives.portrait_note: Cropped from the same master and padded with white headroom so the bottom-anchored phone copy never lands on a face; regenerating the master means re-deriving these.

copy.tagline: 如果物理是一束光，我想让它照到没有实验室的地方
copy.note: Text is rendered by the shell in live text, never baked into the raster — the artwork must stay wordmark-free.
